description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'EventBusCredentialsManagementAdapter' that extends 'EventBusService' and implements 'Verticle'. It serves as an adapter for binding 'CredentialsManagementService' to the Vert.x event bus, handling credential-related request operations such as get and update, and decoding credential data from JSON. The class includes methods for processing requests, decoding credentials, and managing tracing spans, facilitating communication between a credentials management service and the Vert.x event bus within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: EventBusCredentialsManagementAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class that binds 'CredentialsManagementService' to the Vert.x event bus, handling credential-related operations and request processing.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the underlying 'CredentialsManagementService' instance.

methods.name: processCustomCredentialsMessage
methods.description: Handles custom or unsupported credentials messages; defaults to returning a 400 Bad Request error.

methods.name: decodeCredential
methods.description: Decodes a credential JSON object into a 'CommonCredential' subclass based on its 'type' field.

methods.name: decodeCredentials
methods.description: Decodes a JSON array of credential objects into a list of 'CommonCredential' instances.

methods.name: credentialsFromPayload
methods.description: Extracts and decodes credentials from an 'EventBusMessage' payload, returning a Future with the list.

methods.name: processGetRequest
methods.description: Processes a 'get' operation request to retrieve credentials, creating a response with credential data.
